# Golden capture fixtures

These are the unmodified public captures explicitly requested for v0.1. Their source index is [Wireshark SampleCaptures](https://wiki.wireshark.org/SampleCaptures#wifi--wireless-lan-captures--80211).

| File | Source | Packets | Link type | SHA-256 |
| --- | --- | ---: | ---: | --- |
| `wpa-Induction.pcap` | [Original download](https://wiki.wireshark.org/uploads/__moin_import__/attachments/SampleCaptures/wpa-Induction.pcap) | 1093 | 127 | `2b57dca7fa2c3bd0e942060b546028d961bfb698fb12ed8b2947b13f88d170c8` |
| `Network_Join_Nokia_Mobile.pcap` | [Original download](https://wiki.wireshark.org/uploads/__moin_import__/attachments/SampleCaptures/Network_Join_Nokia_Mobile.pcap) | 1180 | 105 | `8c65e7a88d1daff9672f5d15ef3365f1360efbfc631953d75da895ac87e5cd5c` |

Downloaded 2026-09-26. These third-party files contain the original sample network addresses, SSIDs, and payloads. They are test data, not this project's network traffic. No capture-specific license was attached to the source downloads; their inclusion does not claim ownership or relicense them.

The matching `.tsv` files are independent `tshark -T fields` output, not output generated by airtrace. The exact command is in `tools/regenerate-golden.sh`; `TSHARK_VERSION.txt` records the generating version (4.2.2). Decryption is explicitly disabled. Regenerate with:

```sh
sh tools/regenerate-golden.sh
```

The C golden tests compare all 2273 packet rows: timestamps; type and subtype; RSSI and radiotap frequency when available; DS channel; receiver, transmitter, source, destination and BSSID addresses; SSID bytes; sequence number; retry, protection and DS flags; status/reason codes; and four-way handshake classification. Neither sample supplies radiotap dBm signal; the unit tests cover its signed decoding.

Tshark emits `<MISSING>` for the zero-length SSID in frame 583 of `wpa-Induction`; the golden test checks this as a present, empty SSID. WPA frames 21, 43, 574, 607, 623, 681, 692, 752, 1005 and 1074 have unsupported nonzero 802.11 protocol versions. The test verifies `AIRTRACE_ERR_UNSUPPORTED` for these against the `wlan.fc.version` oracle column. They are not silently skipped or treated as valid frames.

The WPA sample has four-way EAPOL messages in frames 87, 89, 92 and 94. The Nokia sample has retransmitted messages in frames 723-726, 728-731, 733-736 and 738-741. These classifications are covered by the golden comparisons.

Normal builds, CTest, and CI read the committed files and do not require network access or tshark. Fuzz seeds are extracted from these same captures by the C `airtrace_seed` utility; see the main README for commands.
